children: Utilities stocks continue to attract investor attention as the sector benefits from stable demand, regulated revenue streams, and increasing focus on clean energy infrastructure.
While utilities are traditionally viewed as defensive holdings, some companies within the sector are posting notable revenue growth while maintaining attractive valuations.

Below is a list of utilities stocks with a Seeking Alpha Valuation Grade of A or better that are ranked according to year-over-year revenue growth. The screen highlights companies operating across gas utilities, electric utilities, renewable electricity, and independent power production, all of which combine solid revenue growth with favorable valuation metrics.
The list is led by National Fuel Gas Company
, which posted year-over-year revenue growth of 15.13%. Edison International
and Genie Energy Ltd.
follow with growth rates of 10.74% and 10.01%, respectively.
Clearway Energy, Inc.
and The AES Corporation
round out the top five with revenue growth of 9.92% and 8.49%. Notably, Edison International carries the highest A+ Valuation Grade among the companies on this list.

Seeking Alpha's Valuation Grade measures how expensive a stock is relative to its fundamentals, with A+ representing the most attractive valuations and F representing the least attractive. The companies below were screened for attractive valuations and are ranked solely according to their year-over-year revenue growth rates.
Here is the list:
